column1: # Scope: actual AssertingPointsFormat writer only; native reader, PointTree and original MergeState retain native algorithm dispatch
# INPUT_DOC case ordinal storedId rank; INPUT_POINT case ordinal field dimensions indexDimensions bytesPerDimension packedHex; duplicate rows preserve multiplicity
# CASE case phase maxDoc numDocs leaves; DOC case phase leaf localDoc live storedId
# FIELD case phase leaf name number dimensions indexDimensions bytesPerDimension size docCount minHex maxHex; missing field number=-1, missing points bounds=-
# POINT case phase leaf field localDoc:packedHex; sorted multiset includes deleted documents before merge, preserves duplicate points
# TREE case phase leaf field pointCount leafCount; default native configuration, fields with >1024 points must have multiple leaves
# RANGE case phase queryOrdinal field inclusiveMin inclusiveMax exactHitCount; RANGE_HIT case phase queryOrdinal globalDoc storedId; independent integer predicate checks every live document
# FLUSH case phase afterInputOrdinal; DELETE case phase storedId; large case commits after ordinals 519,1039,1042: two 1560-point sources plus one point-free source
# CHECKPOINT case phase writersOpened eventCount; TRACE case ordinal phase:writer:event; native merge finishes internally, its finish is not a separate wrapper call
